item.title: JavaScript Methods for Forcing File Downloads from Browser Blob Data
item.description:
“JavaScript Methods for Forcing File Downloads from Browser Blob Data”

Initiating a file download in a web application without navigating to a server endpoint is a frequent requirement. When dealing with data generated client-side (like JSON objects or canvas exports), we often need to force the browser to save this data as a file. This typically involves creating a Blob object and then simulating a user click action.

What are the established, cross-browser mechanisms for achieving this forced download functionality?

item.title: JavaScript window.onbeforeunload: Techniques for Controlling Page Exit Prompts
item.description:
“JavaScript window.onbeforeunload: Techniques for Controlling Page Exit Prompts”

How can web developers effectively manage and implement the window.onbeforeunload mechanism to prompt users before they navigate away from a page containing unsaved data, considering modern browser behavior and compatibility across different environments?

The behavior surrounding the window.onbeforeunload event has evolved significantly. Older techniques relying on returning specific strings are now deprecated or ignored by contemporary browsers due to security concerns. Modern implementations require careful handling, often involving setting specific properties on the event object or using standard event listeners.
